FIXED: /gin/response_writer.go — `responseWriter.WriteHeader` was missing the early `return` after the "Headers were already written" warning, so a late `WriteHeader(code)` overwrote `w.status` with a code that was never actually sent, making `Status()` diverge from the real HTTP status.

Exact diff (`git diff` in /gin):
```
diff --git a/response_writer.go b/response_writer.go
index 77c7ed8..5b74d86 100644
--- a/response_writer.go
+++ b/response_writer.go
@@ -61,6 +61,7 @@ func (w *responseWriter) WriteHeader(code int) {
 	if code > 0 && w.status != code {
 		if w.Written() {
 			debugPrint("[WARNING] Headers were already written. Wanted to override status code %d with %d", w.status, code)
+			return
 		}
 		w.status = code
 	}
```
(1 line added; matches upstream gin behaviour: once the header is written, further `WriteHeader` calls must be ignored, not recorded.)
